name: posters
description: Portable hero posters: `takedown` peels one off the wall (furniture -> rolled item), `putup` hangs a carried poster on the wall of the current room and reports where it falls in the mural. Two-layer easter egg — Kiyo and Cyd were printed as one image, so hanging that pair together reveals a hidden GRU at the seam on examine; hanging all seven sheets in one room spells HELLMOO across the seams.
